subject: computer-science
title: Stakeholders and Requirements
welcome_lead: Capture user needs and balance competing demands of all stakeholders.
meta_desc: CS adventure on stakeholders, requirements gathering, and prototyping.
final_note: Stakeholders include anyone affected - listen widely!

concepts.def: Person or group affected by the system.
Direct user of the deployed software.
Early model used to elicit feedback.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Hospital booking system stakeholders: patients, doctors, receptionists, IT staff.

Each group brings unique requirements and constraints.

Functional: 'system must email a confirmation'.

Non-functional: 'response under 2 seconds, 99.9% uptime'.

Build cheap mock-up, demo to users, gather feedback, iterate.

Reduces risk of misunderstandings before full implementation.
